metadata.description: TheDigitalGriot's unified plugin marketplace — thin per-tool plugin folders (prism, cinopsis, ...) synced from each tool's own repo on release. One marketplace, every Griot tool. Each entry uses a spec-valid relative './<tool>-plugin' source; the repo stays small so the Claude Desktop / Cowork remote backend clones it fast.
